aspect: EXAMPLE - the ranking and the stability
description: Mexico ranks second in the OECD for hours worked per year, and average weekly hours have stayed around 42-43 for the last twenty years.
energy_note: Second in the developed world, for twenty years.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the 40-hour week keeps being proposed
description: Both the 2018-24 and 2024-30 administrations pushed a constitutional reform to cut the week from 48 to 40 hours and increase paid holidays. It remains a proposal rather than a condition of anyone's life.

aspect: The commute is not in the number
description: Hours worked exclude two to four hours a day travelling from the periphery of Mexico City, Monterrey or Guadalajara, which is time gone from the same day.
energy_note: Fourteen hours away from the house, for eight paid.

aspect: What it leaves for anything else
description: Long hours plus commuting plus a second job is why the goodlife dataset's `time` trigger bites hardest here: the good things that require an evening are the ones that do not happen.
energy_note: No hours left in which to have a life.
notes: Interacts with the `time`/`work` triggers in assets/text/goodlife.
